verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable and deliberately regioned, but it lands just above the flat 5 anchor because pervasive plain gray boxes replace registry objects and several loose or boundary-terminating routes keep the otherwise orderly composition from feeling finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The major regions distribute content across the frame with useful separation, though the broad central white channels and sparse upper lifecycle area create mildly dead bands.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Pastel containers distinguish regions, but operational nouns such as Orchestrator, Model, tools, API, snapshots, and child agents are rendered as uniform gray boxes rather than wearing their registry colors.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Several routes terminate or turn at container boundaries and in open space, including the top blue reattach line and orange lifecycle returns, producing ambiguous waypoint-like plumbing despite the absence of explicit crosshairs.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Panels, labels, and repeated nodes generally hold clean local registers, but uneven internal density, oversized note blocks, and long connector runs weaken the main-flow hierarchy.
